findings.title: Narrow the acceptance check to the unsafe queued-work claim
findings.trigger: An executor runs the required plan 90-07 acceptance check on the completed implementation.
findings.execution_path: The recursive grep searches all of triggarr/ for 'never selected', including the orphan-sweep docstring at triggarr/db.py:1627.
findings.consequence: The required empty-output criterion fails on an accurate identity-isolation statement, potentially blocking acceptance or prompting removal of valid documentation.
findings.evidence: The exact command prints triggarr/db.py:1627: 'this sweep repairs. Rows with no stable ID are never selected by any'. It also matches an existing compiled cache file. The statement concerns NULL-ID rows, not the unsafe claim about queued jobs that this check intends to prohibit.
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict the check to the relevant queued-work/removal comment blocks and the specific obsolete claim, and exclude generated binary files.
findings.reproduction_command: grep -rniE "never selected|nobody selects|selected by nobody" triggarr/

limitations: Did not independently run pytest: the read-only sandbox prevents the suite's temporary database and configuration writes. Used the supplied exact-head harness evidence as test evidence, not approval.
No live Arr services or browser rendering were exercised.
Initial large outputs were truncated; smaller subsequent reads covered the omitted in-scope content.
